description: Backend API layer (tasks.md 3.1, Req 9.1): weather detail fields on PreparednessReport, offline scripted agent mode, a local JSON-file assessment store behind an AssessmentStore interface, an in-memory threaded job manager, FastAPI routes (health, create/get assessment job, get report, history with changes, metrics), a JSON error envelope, CORS from config, backend/main.py, offline API tests, and a fixture exporter for the frontend. Implements plan.md items 1-7 and decisions D-M3-1..7. Must run first: FEAT-002 consumes its API contract and fixtures.
steps: Read plan.md (d:\github work\SDK workshop\.agents\tasks\heatwise-m3\plan.md) sections 'Design decisions', Phase 1 and the Digest before editing.

Item 1: backend/config.py add agent_mode (bedrock|offline, default bedrock), assessment_store_dir ('.data/assessments'), api_cors_origins (['http://localhost:5173','http://127.0.0.1:5173']), api_job_workers (2, 1-8), api_max_pending_jobs (20, 1-200) before log_level. backend/models/report.py add current_conditions: CurrentConditions | None, forecast: ForecastResult | None, alerts: AlertsResult | None (default None). backend/agents/coordinator.py build_report sets them from w.current/w.forecast/w.alerts (None when w is None). backend/services/weather/demo.py add DEMO_LOCATIONS = tuple(sorted(_FIXTURES)). Move the full content of backend/tests/scripted_model.py to backend/agents/scripted.py and make the test module re-export ScriptedModel, text, tool_call. Add '.data/' to heatwise-ai/.gitignore and the new env vars (commented defaults) to heatwise-ai/.env.example. Run pytest: 186 passed.

Item 2: create backend/agents/offline.py build_offline_coordinator(settings, location, forecast_days) building HeatWiseCoordinator with ScriptedModels for weather (get_weather/get_forecast/get_weather_alerts with the job location and days, then WeatherSummary with null claims and a number-free sentence), risk (classify_heat_risk then RiskExplanation with a number-free sentence), planner (list_guidance for household, outdoor_worker, farmer with phase='all', then PlanIntro), safety (run_safety_checks then SafetyReview concern=None) and coordinator (the five tools one per turn, then text); weather agent uses build_weather_provider(settings). Add backend/tests/test_offline.py: demo-hot-dry with Settings(_env_file=None, weather_provider='demo') -> complete, data_mode demo, 3 forecast days, current_conditions set; demo-mild -> a lower risk category than demo-hot-dry.

Item 3: create backend/api/schemas.py (PlaceInput{name, district?, state?}, ProfileInput(CommunityProfile) with extra='forbid' and preferred_language regex ^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$, AssessmentRequest{place, forecast_days=3, profile} extra='forbid' with normalize_location on each place part and on the composed location and validate_forecast_days in mode='before' validators, a location property joining non-empty parts with ', ', profile_as_community() -> CommunityProfile; JobError, JobView, HistoryChanges, HistoryItem, HistoryPage, MetricsView, HealthView, ErrorBody). Create backend/session/store.py (AssessmentRecord{report_id, created_at, duration_ms, request: AssessmentRequest, report: PreparednessReport}; AssessmentStore ABC save/get/list(limit, offset)/count/all; JsonFileAssessmentStore(directory) one <report_id>.json per record, temp file + os.replace, threading.Lock, newest first, unreadable files skipped with a log warning). Create backend/api/summaries.py (location_key, history_items with changes vs the previous record of the same key: risk_category from/to, heat_index_c delta, max forecast delta, indicators added/removed; compute_metrics: total, by_status, by_risk_category, by_data_mode, plans_generated, verification passed/failed/not_run, mean_pct_items_verified, mean_duration_ms, null when nothing to average). Add backend/tests/test_store.py covering store and summaries.

Item 4: create backend/api/jobs.py: Job dataclass and JobManager(run_fn, store, max_workers, max_pending, max_retained=200) on a ThreadPoolExecutor; submit raises TooManyJobs when queued+running >= max_pending; worker sets running, measures duration_ms with perf_counter, saves AssessmentRecord, sets succeeded with report_id; exception -> logger.exception and failed with code 'assessment_failed' and a generic message, nothing stored; lock-guarded dict; evict oldest finished jobs over max_retained; shutdown(wait).

Item 5: create backend/api/errors.py (handlers: RequestValidationError -> 422 validation_error with fields [{field: dotted loc without 'body', message without the 'Value error, ' prefix}], StarletteHTTPException -> not_found for 404 else http_<status>, TooManyJobs -> 429 too_many_jobs, Exception -> 500 internal_error, no traces), backend/api/app.py create_app(settings=None, store=None, coordinator_factory=None) with lifespan shutting the JobManager down, CORSMiddleware(allow_origins=settings.api_cors_origins, allow_methods=['GET','POST'], allow_headers=['Content-Type']), default factory per agent_mode (HeatWiseCoordinator(settings) or build_offline_coordinator(settings, req.location, req.forecast_days)), backend/api/routes.py APIRouter(prefix='/api'): GET /health, POST /assessments (202 + Location header), GET /assessments/{job_id}, GET /reports/{report_id}, GET /history?limit=20&offset=0 (limit 1-100), GET /metrics; and backend/main.py app = create_app().

Item 6: create backend/tests/test_api.py with TestClient(create_app(settings, store=JsonFileAssessmentStore(tmp_path), coordinator_factory=...)) used as a context manager; factories built from backend.tests.test_coordinator.build (fresh coordinator per job) and FakeProvider; wait_for polling helper with a 15 s timeout. Cover: job lifecycle incl. queued/running via a threading.Event-blocked factory; validation errors (empty name, control char, days 0/8/true, extra profile field 'name', top-level 'phone', bad language) -> 422 envelope with fields; 404 envelope for unknown job and report; 429 when pending is full; factory exception -> failed job, nothing stored; needs_human_review payload (UNSAFE_PLAN twice, REVIEW twice): verified_item_ids non-empty, checklist_markdown has 'Not verified - needs human review' and no 'aspirin', recommended_actions still has the aspirin item; incomplete path (ProviderTimeoutError for current and forecast): job succeeded, report incomplete, recommended_actions and checklist_markdown null, missing_information mentions provider_timeout; history (two runs same place -> newest first, second has changes, total 2); metrics match stored records and zero state; health in demo lists demo_locations and agent_mode; CORS preflight allowed for http://localhost:5173 and not for http://evil.example; default offline factory end to end with demo-hot-dry.

Item 7: create backend/tests/export_fixtures.py (python -m backend.tests.export_fixtures <out_dir>): report-complete.json, report-needs-review.json, report-incomplete.json from backend.tests.test_cli.scripted_report(Settings(_env_file=None, weather_provider='open_meteo'), kind) and report-demo-complete.json from the offline coordinator with demo-hot-dry, each model_dump_json(indent=2), creating the folder if needed. Smoke-run it into a temp folder and delete the folder afterwards.

findings:
VERIFIED: full pytest 221 passed, 4 deselected (186 baseline + 35 new: test_offline 2, test_store 10, test_api 23), ~11 s, offline (FakeProvider/demo + ScriptedModel only). Routes check prints /api/assessments, /api/assessments/{job_id}, /api/health, /api/history, /api/metrics, /api/reports/{report_id} (+ /docs, /openapi.json, /redoc). Exporter wrote report-complete/needs-review/incomplete/demo-complete.json, all parse with PreparednessReport.model_validate_json (statuses complete/needs_human_review/incomplete/complete); temp folder removed. Importing backend.main does not create .data (store dir is created on first save).
DEVIATIONS: (1) FastAPI 0.162 wraps include_router() in a nested _IncludedRouter without .path, so app.py does app.router.routes.extend(router.routes) (router still APIRouter(prefix='/api')); OpenAPI paths unchanged. (2) AssessmentRequest/PlaceInput/ProfileInput live in backend/api/schemas.py; store.py imports them (single definition). (3) The composed-location check runs in a PlaceInput model_validator, so its 422 field is 'place'. (4) Store.get/save only accept 32-char lowercase hex report ids (non-hex -> 404, avoids path traversal). (5) History computes changes over all stored records, then pages (so a paged item still gets its changes). (6) 422 field names strip only 'body', so query errors read e.g. 'query.limit'. (7) Offline sentences pass claim checks: demo-hot-dry offline run is complete with no steering blocks.
API SHAPES for FEAT-002 (types.ts):
- Request POST /api/assessments: {place:{name, district?, state?}, forecast_days?:1-7 (default 3), profile?:{elderly, young_children, pregnant_women, chronic_illness_group, outdoor_workers, farmers, limited_water_access, limited_shade_or_cooling (bools), terrain:'plains'|'hilly'|'coastal'|null, preferred_language (^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$, default 'en')}}; extra keys anywhere -> 422. Empty-string district/state become null. Response 202 JobView + Location: /api/assessments/{job_id}.
- JobView: {job_id, status:'queued'|'running'|'succeeded'|'failed', created_at, started_at|null, finished_at|null, duration_ms|null, report_id|null, error:{code,message}|null (failed -> code 'assessment_failed'), request:AssessmentRequest (place has district/state null when absent), report:PreparednessReport|null (only when succeeded)}.
- GET /api/reports/{report_id} -> AssessmentRecord {report_id, created_at, duration_ms, request, report}.
- PreparednessReport gains current_conditions (CurrentConditions: location, temperature_c, apparent_temperature_c, relative_humidity_pct, wind_speed_kmh, precipitation_mm, provenance), forecast (ForecastResult: location, days[{date, temperature_max_c, temperature_min_c, apparent_temperature_max_c, precipitation_sum_mm, uv_index_max, relative_humidity_max_pct}], provenance, note), alerts (AlertsResult: location, alerts_supported, alerts, explanation, official_sources, provenance); all nullable (null in the incomplete fixture).
- GET /api/history?limit=20&offset=0 (limit 1-100, offset >=0) -> HistoryPage {items, total, limit, offset}; HistoryItem {report_id, created_at, duration_ms, query, location_name, admin1, country, status, risk_category, heat_index_c, max_forecast_c, indicators[] (from request profile), data_mode:'live'|'demo'|null, verification_status, changes|null}; HistoryChanges {previous_report_id, previous_created_at, risk_category_from, risk_category_to, heat_index_delta_c|null, max_forecast_delta_c|null (1 decimal), indicators_added[], indicators_removed[]}. Location key = name|admin1|country lowercased, else query.
- GET /api/metrics -> {total, by_status{complete,needs_human_review,incomplete}, by_risk_category{low,moderate,high,very_high,extreme,unknown}, by_data_mode{live,demo[,unknown when data_mode null, e.g. incomplete]}, plans_generated, verification{passed,failed,not_run}, mean_pct_items_verified (0-100, 1 decimal)|null, mean_duration_ms|null}; all keys pre-seeded with 0.
- GET /api/health -> {status:'ok', version:'0.1.0', weather_provider, agent_mode, model_id (only when agent_mode=bedrock), demo_locations (only when weather_provider=demo: ['demo-hot-dry','demo-humid-coast','demo-mild'])}; absent keys are omitted, not null.
- Errors: {error:{code, message, fields:[{field, message}]}}: validation_error 422 (field dotted e.g. 'place.name', 'forecast_days', 'profile.name', 'phone', 'profile.preferred_language', 'place'; messages without 'Value error, ', e.g. 'Forecast days must be between 1 and 7.'), not_found 404, http_405 etc., too_many_jobs 429, internal_error 500. CORS preflight from a disallowed origin gets Starlette's plain 400 (no allow-origin header), not the envelope.
